verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a drag-and-drop, node-based visual flow builder ('Retell agents are node-based flows or single prompts') with branching structure, plus dedicated no-code nodes/tools for handoffs like transfer-call, end-call, function calling, and SMS, and a template-based quickstart requiring no coding. Community evidence corroborates real usage of these voice agents built via the platform, though it also surfaces occasional conversational logic errors rather than builder failures. Missing for 10: independent hands-on review specifically of the visual builder UI/branching experience (community evidence focuses on conversation quality, not the builder itself), and no video/screenshot walkthrough of complex branching states.
